intro: A mother trusts a gadget more than her own child, and the result is devastating. This is not a feel-good watch: it is a family tragedy about a truth band that gets it wrong and a parent who refuses to listen. Keep tissues close and expect to be angry on Lily's behalf.
why: A gut-punch premise that turns a simple device into the villain of a family story.
Told partly through a ghost's eyes, which makes every wrong accusation hurt more.
A sharp look at parents who believe a screen over their kids.
Good pick if you like tearjerkers and family dramas where the truth comes out too late.
